profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Highly motivated and results-oriented team player with a strong sense of urgency.
Proven ability to focus on reusability to improve team productivity and reduce costs.
Experience in implementing proof of concepts, coding standards, and technical proposals.
Expertise in object-oriented principles, enterprise application integration, continuous integration and continuous delivery, configuration management, and distributed/clustered systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: One of the senior engineers involved in all development phases of the latest release of the Election Management System product.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · RESTful WebServices · Back-End Web Development · Mockito · Git · Relational Databases · Microservices · Java Frameworks

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: SQL · RESTful WebServices · Back-End Web Development · Mockito · Git · Apache Kafka · Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) Architecture · Relational Databases · Jenkins · Microservices · Java Frameworks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Help the company develop a new version of one of its products from the ground up using best development practices, Java related technologies such as Maven, JEE, OSGi, REST webservices, Apache Camel, ActiveMQ, Groovy, and Wildfly.

positions.title: Technical Leader
Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintain the customer`s server side framework based on EJB, fix bugs, follow Scrum dailies with San Francisco and New York teams

positions.title: Java Technical Lead
positions.description: Interact with both Project Managers and Business Analysts in order to help the development team to deliver releases on schedule; coach technical team tasks; apply Erich Gamma design patterns; assure project adherence with CMMI standards to help the company to achieve the certification (levels 3 and 5); design and implement SOA services using at first BEA Aqualogic and then, after BEA acquisition by Oracle, migrating the whole solution to the new platform Oracle Service Bus; design high performance tests and evaluation; periodically follow up with customer’s team.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description: Coaching during the main development stage, mentoring the less experienced team members, teach Java, JEE, architecture foundation and design patterns.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: User requirements documentation review, programming use cases on JEE and Java SE.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Redesign company’s process for building and buying software, support the interface between internal users and software vendors, support the internal development (specifics needs) from requirements to deployement, manage and rescale IT infraestructure like desktop stations, physical and logical network, application’s servers.

projects.title: Election Management
projects.description: Automates election office operations through a complete end-to-end online application.
